rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for sports involving unusual danger, speed, height, exertion, or spectacular stunts.

example.english: Paragliding is an extreme sport, so you have to be very careful even though it is exciting.
example.traditional: 滑翔傘係一種極限運動，刺激得嚟又要好小心。

rows.note: Use this when you specifically want to stress the danger of the sport rather than its technical or spectacular nature.

example.english: Before taking part in an extreme sport, remember to get insurance and wear a helmet.
example.traditional: 玩高危運動之前，記得買齊保險同戴好頭盔。
